title: Exploring the relationship between TMT behavioral integration and environmental performance in Pakistani SMEs: a study of green innovation, green dynamic capabilities, and green finance
core_idea: This study investigates how behavioral integration of top management teams (TMTBI) relates to environmental performance (EP) in Pakistani manufacturing SMEs, examining whether TMTs' green dynamic capabilities (GDC) and green innovation (GI) mediate that relationship and whether green finance (GF) moderates it. The research is framed by upper echelons, resource-based view, and AMO theories and uses a survey-based structural equation modeling approach.
tldr: The paper examines whether and how TMT behavioral integration influences SMEs' environmental performance via green dynamic capabilities and green innovation, and whether green finance strengthens this link.
